programme.title: Storage Wars - Crickets and Wickets

programme.title: Storage Wars - Ivy Gets the Runaround
programme.desc: S11E17 - In Stanton, Calif., Dave learns that making a profit is sometimes like pulling teeth; Mary grinds to get into the black; Ivy's locker ends up sucking and blowing. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Grandma to the Rescue
programme.desc: S5E8 - A resort guest's confrontation with a group of performers escalates into an explosive altercation; chaos ensues when two alleged shoplifters are locked inside by a security guard; three friends' bickering turns physical. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Lost & Found
programme.desc: S9E7 - At a California sandwich shop, after an employee gets his order wrong, a customer seems more interested in making a point than getting a replacement; at an airport terminal in Florida, the police are called in to settle a disturbance when a customer can't find her luggage; in a Florida fast-food restaurant, a clash between two customers and an employee turns physical; at a hotel in Thailand, a customer's anger erupts as he believes he was charged twice for his family's rooms. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Check Please
programme.desc: S9E4 - At a fast-food restaurant in Florissant, Missouri, tensions rise when the husband of a customer accused of a bad parking job confronts her accuser; in Ft. Lauderdale, Florida, officers are called to a restaurant after a woman reportedly has issues settling her sizable tab; in Kazakhstan, a terrifying scene unfolds at an airport when a blade-wielding man takes an employee hostage inside the terminal. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Line Fail
programme.desc: S9E5 - In a New Jersey coffeehouse, a customer hoping to purchase a sought-after limited edition coffee mug apparently lines up at the wrong door; at an airport in Florida, police respond to an allegedly intoxicated passenger who refuses to leave the plane after being asked to depart; at an Ohio gas station, a dispute apparently over a simple food purchase quickly turns violent; on an Island near Bali, an American tourist's getaway turns terrifying when their ferry home starts to take on water. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Iced Out
programme.desc: S8E4 - On a train in New York City, a woman becomes upset after hearing a group of tourists speak in their native language; in Key West, Florida, police intervene at a local bar where two men get into a confrontation with another customer; at a convenience store in Australia, a customer and employee have a heated exchange over an attempted frozen drink purchase; on a runway at a Toronto airport, a passenger records as a routine landing takes a terrifying turn. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Passenger Problems
programme.desc: S6E4 - On a bus in Los Angeles, Calif., tensions rise over a woman's refusal to give up her seat to accommodate a wheel-chaired passenger; in West Palm Beach, Fla., a woman fails to comply with police. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Return Rebellion
programme.desc: S9E6 - In Estes Park, Colorado, two customers attempt to return their purchases after the store owner allegedly makes an offensive remark about them to another shopper; at a fast-food restaurant in Rockledge, Florida, police are called to remove a disgruntled customer who refuses to leave; in a Richmond, Canada supermarket parking lot, a bystander films a heated brawl that erupts when two elderly women vie for a handicap spot. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Pay Now, Eat Later
programme.desc: S6E10 - At LAX, a woman speaks disrespectfully to a man and his family, prompting him to confront her; a customer and a restaurant manager get into a heated argument over the restaurant's payment policy. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Drive-Thru Debacle
programme.desc: S3E24 - In Augusta, Ga., disaster unfolds as a truck attempts to purchase food at a drive through; at a Dallas airport, a passenger's rudeness sparks a chaotic brawl among travelers; in Melbourne, Australia, a ride-share driver gets a very pleasant surprise. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - War of the Words
programme.desc: S4E14 - On a bus in Maryland, a heated argument between two passengers escalates to a dangerous breaking point; in a New York City pet store, a woman is asked to leave after kicking a puppy's kennel, and her reaction is shocking. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Do Not Disturb
programme.desc: S6E3 - In Allen, Texas, a parking lot dispute turns into a bizarre tirade of passive-aggressive insults; at a luxury hotel in West Palm Beach, Florida, an unruly guest clashes with staff and police. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Fire Drill
programme.desc: S9E8 - In Warwick, New York, a fast-food customer assists with a flaming kitchen appliance as employees appear not to notice; police responding to a call about a disturbance at a hotel in Downers Grove, Illinois, attempt to reason with an allegedly intoxicated man who claims to be a mixed martial artist; in Anaheim, California, a brawl erupts at a supercross race after a spectator is confronted for allegedly smoking in the stands. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Road Wars - Parking Space Invaders
programme.desc: S8E7 - A family's fierce defense of a parking space turns contentious with Florida officers; an SUV passes on the shoulder of a Virginia freeway with disastrous results; a motorist in China is run over by his own sedan; a car carrier's cargo bursts into flames in a New Jersey parking lot; a glitchy stop sign on a school bus causes a traffic jam in New York. programme.title: Road Wars - Flippin' Tow Truck
programme.desc: S4E12 - A confrontation between motorists in Toronto turns into a group rumble in the street; in Texas, an ex-convict risks his life to save a wounded officer during a freeway shootout; a bus driver working the early morning shift causes a six-car pileup in Colorado; in Cleveland, a tow truck flips a disabled vehicle into oncoming highway traffic with the driver still inside. programme.title: Road Wars - Construction Truck Catastrophe

programme.title: Road Wars - Wake-Up Call

programme.title: Road Wars - Swarm of Bees

programme.title: Road Wars - Gas Station Blowout

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Steven Universe
programme.desc: The Crystal Gems are a team of magical beings who are the self-appointed guardians of the universe. Half-human, half-Gem hero Steven is the "little brother" of the group. The goofball is learning to save the world using the magical powers that come from his bellybutton and he goes on magical adventures with the rest of the Crystal Gems, even though he's not as powerful -- or smart -- as fellow group members Garnet, Amethyst and Pearl. Despite his shortcomings, Steven usually finds a surprising way to save the day. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy, Action)

programme.title: Holiday Wars - The Great Turkey Escape

programme.title: Holiday Wars - When Toys Come Alive ... And Go Wild

programme.title: Holiday Wars - North Pole Wedding

(Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Wars - Critter Christmas

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown - I'm Dreaming of a Bright Christmas
programme.desc: S1E3 - Host Jesse Palmer challenges the teams to create a holiday light show out of gingerbread and pair their glittering creations with the lightest of all desserts: choux pastry; judges Nacho Aguirre, Kardea Brown and Breegan Jane choose the winning team. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown - Best in Show
programme.desc: S1E1 - The baking teams are tasked with creating holiday memory snow globe scenes in gingerbread; they must also make a treat using the most common baking ingredient to represent snow — coconut. (Holiday, Cooking, Competition reality)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown - Have Yourself a Scary Little Christmas

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Holiday Beauty

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Holiday Imagination
programme.desc: S10E6 - After learning the latke basics, Jesse Palmer has the bakers fry up latke-inspired desserts; the bakers' imaginations run wild while creating letterboard holiday bars to put judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller in the holiday spirit. (Reality, Cooking, Holiday)

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Reasons for the Season

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship - Holiday Gifts Galore

programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. programme.desc: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: Tourists fall prey to carnivorous vines ensnaring the ruins of an ancient Mayan temple.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A bungling gangster (Brad Pitt) must reform to please his girlfriend (Julia Roberts) but still has one last job to fulfill.

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: Two bullets force a career-driven Manhattan lawyer (Harrison Ford) to start life over with his loving wife (Annette Bening) and daughter.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: A one-time tennis professional (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) becomes obsessed with his brother-in-law's (Matthew Goode) seductive fiancée (Scarlett Johansson).

programme.title: Haunter
programme.desc: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living.

programme.title: The Butcher's Wife
programme.desc: A folksy seaside clairvoyant (Demi Moore) marries a New York butcher (George Dzundza), moves to the city and charms her new neighbors.

programme.title: A Very Brady Sequel
programme.desc: A man claiming to be Carol Brady's long-lost first husband, Roy Martin, shows up at the suburban Brady residence one evening.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

programme.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
programme.desc: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician.

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. - Nicole Kidman, Matthew Broderick, Bette Midler, Glenn Close, Christopher Walken (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction)

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. - Helen Mirren, Jason Clarke, Sarah Snook, Angus Sampson, Laura Brent (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. - Elizabeth Banks, Emily Browning, Arielle Kebbel, David Strathairn, Jesse Moss (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. - Ellen Page, Sam Keeley, Tom Vaughan-Lawlor, Stuart Graham, Peter Campion (Horror, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Haunter
programme.desc: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. - Abigail Breslin, Stephen McHattie, Peter Outerbridge, Michelle Nolden, David Hewlett (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. - Adam Sandler, Jennifer Aniston, Nicole Kidman, Nick Swardson, Brooklyn Decker (Romantic comedy, Comedy)

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater. - Gillian Jacobs, Jemaine Clement, Josh Wiggins, Forrest Goodluck, Khloe Janel (Comedy)

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Gemma Jones, Jim Broadbent (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. - Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant, Colin Firth, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Proof
programme.desc: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Anthony Hopkins, Jake Gyllenhaal, Hope Davis, Gary Houston (Drama)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules. - Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway, Rene Russo, Anders Holm, JoJo Kushner (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Up in the Air
programme.desc: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light. - George Clooney, Vera Farmiga, Anna Kendrick, Jason Bateman, Danny McBride (Comedy drama, Romance)

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity. - John Cusack, Kate Beckinsale, Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven, John Corbett (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: In 1977, college graduates Harry Burns (Billy Crystal) and Sally Albright (Meg Ryan) share a contentious car ride from Chicago to New York, during which they argue about whether men and women can ever truly be strictly platonic friends. Ten years later, Harry and Sally meet again at a bookstore, and in the company of their respective best friends, Jess (Bruno Kirby) and Marie (Carrie Fisher), attempt to stay friends without sex becoming an issue between them. - Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Carrie Fisher, Bruno Kirby, Steven Ford (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act. - Amy Schumer, Bill Hader, Brie Larson, Colin Quinn, John Cena (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Wrapped Up in Christmas
programme.desc: With Christmas just around the corner, 8-year-old Molly asks the mall Santa to find a boyfriend for her beloved aunt. - Tatyana Ali, Brendan Fehr, Kim Fields, Jasmine Guy, Joseph Marcell (Holiday, Romance)

programme.title: The Wedding Date
programme.desc: With the wedding of her younger sister (Amy Adams) fast approaching, Kat Ellis (Debra Messing) faces the undesirable prospect of traveling alone to London for the ceremony. While this is bad enough, Jeffrey (Jeremy Sheffield), the man who left her as they moved closer to marriage, happens to be the groom's best man. Determined to show everyone -- most of all Jeffrey -- that her romantic life is as full and thrilling as ever, Kat hires a charming male escort (Dermot Mulroney) as her date. - Debra Messing, Dermot Mulroney, Amy Adams, Jack Davenport, Sarah Parish (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Paige and Leo are happily married newlyweds, but their idyllic life together suddenly shatters when a car accident leaves her in a coma. When Paige awakes, she has severe memory loss and doesn't know Leo. She also has a confusing relationship with her parents and still harbors feelings for a former fiancé. Despite these difficult obstacles, Leo is determined to renew their bond and rebuild their marriage. - Rachel McAdams, Channing Tatum, Sam Neill, Scott Speedman, Wendy Crewson (Romance, Drama)

programme.title: In the Grey
programme.desc: A covert team of elite operatives live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival. - Jake Gyllenhaal, Henry Cavill, Eiza González, Kristofer Hivju, Fisher Stevens (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Trainwreck

programme.title: Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken
programme.desc: Sweet and awkward 16-year-old Ruby Gillman is desperate to fit in at school, but she mostly just feels invisible. She's prevented from hanging out with the cool kids at the beach because her over-protective mom forbids her from getting in the water. When she breaks her mom's rule, Ruby discovers that she is a descendant of the warrior Kraken queens and is destined to inherit the throne from her grandmother. The Kraken are sworn to protect the world's oceans against vain, power-hungry mermaids. (Animated, Family, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Migration
programme.desc: A family of ducks decides to leave the safety of a New England pond for an adventurous trip to Jamaica. However, their well-laid plans quickly go awry when they get lost and wind up in New York City. The experience soon inspires them to expand their horizons, open themselves up to new friends, and accomplish more than they ever thought possible. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Croods: A New Age
programme.desc: Searching for a safer habitat, the prehistoric Crood family discovers an idyllic, walled-in paradise that meets all of its needs. Unfortunately, they must also learn to live with the Bettermans -- a family that's a couple of steps above the Croods on the evolutionary ladder. As tensions between the new neighbors start to rise, a new threat soon propels both clans on an epic adventure that forces them to embrace their differences, draw strength from one another, and survive together. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: FBI - Leverage

programme.title: FBI - Fathers and Sons
